summary: Valens Semiconductor filed a 6-K announcing the appointment of Dean Martin as SVP, Head of the Automotive Business Unit, effective September 1, 2026, succeeding Adar Segal, who is stepping down. The filing is a routine leadership transition, not a forced departure or major event. CEO Yoram Salinger commented on Martin's automotive industry experience and commercial track record. No financial terms, advisors, or strategic review details were disclosed. The registrant is the issuer/filer. What to watch: whether this transition signals any shift in automotive strategy or future executive changes; otherwise it is a routine management appointment.
